body.en: The session measured attitudes towards five grounds named in Article 15(1) of the Constitution: religion, race, caste, sex and place of birth. Every ground was named on the first screen; none was hidden.
body.hinglish: Session ne Samvidhan ke Article 15(1) ke paanch aadharon ke prati attitudes mape: religion, race, caste, sex aur place of birth. Har aadhar pehli screen par bataya gaya tha; koi chhupaya nahin gaya.

body.en: Each ground had its own cue on the cards. Sex: the name, and on human cards the figure. Religion: the first name. Caste: the surname. Race: the skin tone of the human figure, which measures colourism, a stand-in for race and not race itself. Place of birth: a 'Born in' line. A surname and a 'Born in' line never appeared on the same character.
body.hinglish: Har aadhar ka cards par apna cue tha. Sex: naam, aur insaani cards par figure. Religion: pehla naam. Caste: surname. Race: insaani figure ki twacha ka rang, jo colourism mapta hai, race ka ek pratinidhi, khud race nahin. Place of birth: 'Janm sthaan' wali line. Surname aur 'Janm sthaan' line kabhi ek hi character par nahin aaye.

body.en: The descriptions on each card were the same for everybody. The tool drew everything else at random, separately for every card and every player: which characters were women and which men, every other cue, whether the card showed animals or humans, the language, and the order in which the characters first appeared.
body.hinglish: Har card ki descriptions sab ke liye ek jaisi thi. Baaki sab tool ne random chuna, har card aur har player ke liye alag: kaun se characters aurat aur kaun aadmi, baaki har cue, card par jaanwar the ya insaan, bhasha, aur characters pehle kis order mein dikhe.

body.en: Because the cues were drawn at random, they cannot line up with the descriptions by chance across a group. If a group's decisions follow a cue, that pattern comes from the decisions.
body.hinglish: Kyunki cues random chune gaye, poore group mein woh descriptions ke saath sanyog se mel nahin kha sakte. Agar group ke decisions kisi cue ke saath chalte hain, to yeh pattern decisions se aata hai.

body.en: A random share of players saw each card with no cue at all: animals with neutral names, no surname and no 'Born in' line. How those players ranked the descriptions is each description's merit-only rank. Merit was defined this way, by the same population with no ground shown, never by a panel's opinion.
body.hinglish: Players ke ek random hisse ne har card bina kisi cue ke dekha: neutral naam wale jaanwar, na surname, na 'Janm sthaan' line. Un players ne descriptions ko jaise rank kiya, wahi har description ka merit-only rank hai. Merit aise hi tay hua, usi population se bina kisi aadhar ke, kabhi kisi panel ki raay se nahin.

body.en: For a group, the study reads how far decisions move away from the merit-only rank in step with a cue: the cue's weight. Beside it, it reads how closely decisions follow the descriptions: the descriptions' weight. Decisions that do not follow the descriptions at all are read as not engaged, never as fair.
body.hinglish: Group ke liye, study padhti hai ki decisions kisi cue ke saath merit-only rank se kitna hat-te hain: cue ka weight. Iske saath, woh padhti hai ki decisions descriptions ko kitna follow karte hain: descriptions ka weight. Jo decisions descriptions ko bilkul follow nahin karte, unhe not engaged padha jaata hai, kabhi fair nahin.

body.en: A player who ranked on the descriptions and gave the cues no weight is read as at merit. No answer on any card was right or wrong, and no individual result was ever computed for release.
body.hinglish: Jis player ne descriptions par rank kiya aur cues ko koi weight nahin diya, use at merit padha jaata hai. Kisi card par koi jawab sahi ya galat nahin tha, aur release ke liye kabhi koi vyaktigat nateeja nahin nikala gaya.

body.en: Half the statements had the fair answer at 'strongly agree' and half at 'strongly disagree', so ticking one option throughout, or answering at random, reads as the middle of the scale, never as fair. Some statements were asked twice, apart; answers that did not agree with themselves are read as not reading the statements. These are real items: there was no trick question.
body.hinglish: Aadhe kathanon ka fair jawab 'bilkul sehmat' par tha aur aadhe ka 'bilkul asehmat' par, isliye poore samay ek hi option chunna, ya random jawab dena, scale ke beech mein padha jaata hai, kabhi fair nahin. Kuch kathan do baar, door door poochhe gaye; jo jawab aapas mein mel nahin khaate, unhe kathan na padhne wala maana jaata hai. Yeh asli sawaal hain: koi trick sawaal nahin tha.

heading.en: Two things the consent screen did not say
heading.hinglish: Do baatein jo consent screen ne nahin batayin

body.en: First, which note a player received, and whether a player answered the extra privacy-format statements, depended on the player's answers to the short questions after the first cards. Saying so in advance would have let players steer those answers. Within each group of players, the note was drawn at random.
body.hinglish: Pehli, kis player ko kaun sa note mila, aur kya player ne privacy format ke extra kathan diye, yeh pehle cards ke baad ke chhote sawaalon ke jawabon par nirbhar tha. Pehle batane se players un jawabon ko mod sakte the. Har group ke andar note random chuna gaya.

body.en: Second, consent said only that a note might ask you to answer in a particular way. It did not quote the notes, because quoting the one that asks for a particular way of answering would have shaped everyone's play. These were the two notes, word for word:
body.hinglish: Doosri, consent ne sirf itna kaha ki ek note aapse kisi khaas tarah jawab dene ko keh sakta hai. Usne notes quote nahin kiye, kyunki khaas tarah jawab maangne wale note ko quote karne se sab ka khel badal jaata. Yeh do notes the, shabdash:

body.en: Note b: [PLACEHOLDER: a sourced statistic on how many Indian employees travel to work by public transport each day goes here.] Source: [PLACEHOLDER: source to be confirmed] For the next part, the rounds and the questions after them, answer as you would.
body.hinglish: Note b: [PLACEHOLDER: a sourced statistic on how many Indian employees travel to work by public transport each day goes here.] Source: [PLACEHOLDER: source to be confirmed] For the next part, the rounds and the questions after them, answer as you would.

body.en: Note c: [PLACEHOLDER: a sourced statistic on how many Indian employees travel to work by public transport each day goes here.] Source: [PLACEHOLDER: source to be confirmed] For the next part, the rounds and the questions after them, answer as the ideal employee would.
body.hinglish: Note c: [PLACEHOLDER: a sourced statistic on how many Indian employees travel to work by public transport each day goes here.] Source: [PLACEHOLDER: source to be confirmed] For the next part, the rounds and the questions after them, answer as the ideal employee would.

heading.hinglish: Kaun kya dekhta hai, aur withdraw karna

body.en: Every ground's result is measured for groups only, and released only for groups of 50 or more people. Smaller groups are merged or left out.
body.hinglish: Har aadhar ka nateeja sirf groups ke liye mapa jaata hai, aur sirf 50 ya usse zyaada logon ke groups ke liye release hota hai. Chhote groups mila diye jaate hain ya chhod diye jaate hain.

body.en: No employer takes part in this study. Every result, including each group's background mix, is research only.
body.hinglish: Is study mein koi employer hissa nahin leta. Har nateeja, har group ke background mix samet, sirf research ke liye hai.

body.en: You can still withdraw: enter your code on the withdrawal page until two weeks after this page opened. Withdrawing deletes every record that carries your code. After that, every code is destroyed and no record can be linked to a code again.
body.hinglish: Aap ab bhi withdraw kar sakte hain: is page ke khulne ke do hafte baad tak withdrawal page par apna code daaliye. Withdraw karne se aapke code wale saare records mit jaate hain. Uske baad saare codes nasht kar diye jaate hain aur koi record dobara kisi code se joda nahin ja sakta.
